 Dolores Huerta's legacy honored during Bakersfield memorial service
 California leaders, including Governor-elect Xavier Becerra and Attorney General Rob Bonta, joined hundreds of others in paying respects to late labor leader Dolores Huerta at her memorial in Bakersfield on Friday. Zach Boetto reports.
